name: table
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact dinner-table illustration. The only substantive change: there must be EXACTLY SIX separate cobalt blue inflated balloon chairs surrounding the same circular cream pedestal table, and SIX corresponding cream plates with silver-lavender cutlery and cream invitations sealed in pink. Original currently has five chairs. Arrange six distinct visible chairs evenly around the circular table: two across the far/top arc, one at middle-left, one at middle-right, two across the near/bottom arc. Count exactly 2+1+1+2 = SIX. All six chair backs must be visible and easy to count, no hidden chair, no seventh chair. Preserve the table's circular shape, cream material, pedestal, blue balloon chair design, pink seals, sculptural cream vase with navy/pink leaves and cream footed grape bowl; same camera angle, same materials and palette, same soft lighting. Adjust placement minimally to fit sixth chair and place setting; do not redesign the scene. No people, no text, no new props. Preserve transparent background. Full chairs including legs inside image margins, smooth clean alpha edges.
